Package com.splendor.model

Class GameState

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.model.GameState
public class GameState extends Object
Represents the current phase of a Splendor game's lifecycle. A Splendor game progresses through three distinct phases:
  1. GameState.Phase.ONGOING - Normal gameplay; no player has reached the winning point threshold
  2. GameState.Phase.FINAL_ROUND - Triggered when a player reaches the winning threshold; all other players get one final turn to try to win
  3. GameState.Phase.FINISHED - All players have completed their final turn; the winner is determined

This class uses the Singleton pattern with predefined instances (ONGOING, FINAL_ROUND, FINISHED) to ensure consistent state objects throughout the application.

The state transitions are strictly unidirectional: ONGOING → FINAL_ROUND → FINISHED

State transition validation is handled by GameRuleValidator.

See Also:
  • For checking if the game has ended
  • GameRuleValidator.validateStateTransition(GameState, GameState)
